import sys
lines = sys.stdin.read().strip().split("\n")
n = int(lines[0])
acc = []
for l in lines[1:1 + n]:
    r, s, e = l.split()
    s, e = int(s), int(e)
    if any(r == r2 and s < e2 and s2 < e for r2, s2, e2 in acc):
        print("REJECTED")
    else:
        acc.append((r, s, e))
        print("ACCEPTED")

programs.svk_invoice_3_code:
import sys
sub, rate, msgs = 0, 0, []
for l in sys.stdin.read().strip().split("\n"):
    l = l.strip()
    if l == "END":
        break
    parts = l.split()
    if parts[0] == "CODE":
        if parts[1] == "SAVE10":
            rate = 0.1
        else:
            msgs.append(f"Invalid code: {parts[1]}")
        continue
    item, q, p = parts
    sub += int(q) * float(p)
disc = sub * rate
vat = (sub - disc) * 0.2
for m in msgs:
    print(m)
print(f"Subtotal: {sub:.2f}")
print(f"Discount: {disc:.2f}")
print(f"VAT: {vat:.2f}")
print(f"Total: {sub - disc + vat:.2f}")

import sys
lines = sys.stdin.read().strip().split("\n")
n = int(lines[0])
tasks = []
for l in lines[1:1 + n]:
    t, p = l.rsplit(",", 1)
    tasks.append((int(p), t.strip()))
for p, t in sorted(tasks):
    print(f"[{p}] {t}")
